main.name: Jeremiah Butler
main.description: 10+ years owning platform systems across high-scale commerce, enterprise cloud, and defense
main.bio: Software engineer with 10+ years owning platform systems across high-scale commerce, enterprise cloud, and defense. Owned the Shopify APIs that every third-party subscription app builds on. Current focus is autonomous agent systems: orchestration, durable execution, and AI-assisted engineering practices adopted by other teams. Takes on problems without a clear owner: a single-value limit baked into a core model, a failing on-call rotation, an innersource community of 100+ projects.

work.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Built autonomous agent systems: integrated coding agents with Shopify's durable agent infrastructure so agent sessions ran unattended and survived restarts for day-to-day IC work; orchestrated multiple concurrent sessions through a voice-controlled conductor agent over an agent control plane

Drove AI-assisted engineering on the team: authored code-review agent skills that repeatedly caught bugs and design flaws human reviewers missed, and were adopted by teammates on that track record; presented autonomous agent-loop techniques to hundreds of engineers on Shopify's internal broadcast platform
Owned the platform Subscriptions and Pre-orders APIs that all Shopify subscription apps build on

Redesigned a core subscriptions data model that owned data it shouldn't and constrained it to a single instance; extracted the data onto its own model and refactored the relationship to support N, with a live backfill of existing records
Built and maintained the open-source Subscriptions reference app: Shopify's first-party subscriptions product and the foundation enterprise merchants fork for bespoke subscription experiences

Restructured team on-call and resiliency practices; built an agent that routed, categorized, and drafted root-cause analysis for incoming support requests, adopted by the team to absorb intake while burning down a backlog of ~20 resiliency issues to zero in 4 months; organized BFCM Game Day exercises (fault injection, monitoring hardening, mock support requests) ahead of peak load
Led 2 cross-team initiatives spanning B2B, checkout, legal, and UX
Mentored a junior engineer through to a senior promotion, plus 2 interns

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Published a generalized ETL collection framework, adopted into the SevOne product to replace one-off legacy Go and Python collectors; used it to build gNMI device collection
Developed a hybrid-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) monitoring solution for the SevOne Network Performance Management platform
Ran twice-weekly code katas; team served as the model for the SevOne org's agile + DevOps migration

work.title: Advanced Software Engineer / Software Lead
bullets: Software technical lead on a microservice architecture for radio operators that won a $30M+ contract award; led multiple teams through the test events behind it
Architected cloud-based mission systems for DoD; led internal research bringing ML to the tactical edge
Built an innersource community with 100+ reusable projects; presented the concept to 130+ participants
